about: The lanes between Dinis Cruz and incident.conductor@web-summit.dinis (incident.identity@web-summit.dinis, 10 November 2026; the design is SECURITY.md). Public on purpose: an append token can only write to its lane, and the recipient's key can only encrypt. No lane exists yet: creating one needs an SG/Send access token and Dinis's yes (agents/identity/status.json).

to_conductor.what: Dinis's feedback, signed by his key and sealed in his browser to the recipient's key (app/login/lane.js).

to_dinis.what: The conductor's replies, signed by its key and sealed to Dinis's key (tools/lane-seal.mjs). Until his bridge vault exists and he says otherwise: ciphertext in this repository.
